experimental_method: Variable-volume view cell with sampling bombs; vapour composition by GC, liquid gas content from pressure of degassed sample (Peng-Robinson) and GC.
uncertainties_stated: vapour mole fractions +/-2.0 %, liquid +/-3.0 %; repeatability 1.5 % (vapour) and 2.0 % (liquid); T better than +/-0.05 K; p +/-0.125 %
quality_remarks: In the HTML DOM the block label ('8.0 MPa, 308.15 K') shares the first data row of each block; it was split into its own label row, no numbers changed.
Water in the vapour phase not reported; y1, y2 on water-free basis.
Table 2 liquid mole fractions are salt-free; the 5.0 wt % mixed salt (NaCl, KCl, CaCl2 1:1:1) is given on a gas-free basis in the title.
Printed digits vary between columns (e.g. x1 '0.00' vs '0.000', '1.01', '1.22'); kept verbatim.
Figure captions list '308.15 K, 12.0 MPa' twice (second should be 16.0 MPa); not table-related.
Setschenow constants quoted in the text (23.7 N2, 10.4 CO2) are derived, not extracted.
Abstract ranges (308.15 and 318.15 K, 8, 12, 16 MPa; salt run at 308.15 K, 8.0 MPa) agree with the tables.
Temperature scale not stated; pressure absolute/gauge not stated.
